layout: Three-panel vertical flex layout: #top-bar (36px) → #canvas-wrapper (flex:1, fills remaining) → #bottom-panel (flex-shrink, min 140px, max 200px). Minimap overlays bottom-right of canvas.

panels.description: Resource HUD. Position: top of screen, fixed height 36px, gradient background (#2a2010→#1a1408), border-bottom 2px. Shows: 🔵 Gold count (gold), 🪵 Wood count, 🍖 Food count / max, and game timer (MM:SS, right-aligned). Debug info inline below gold.
Main game viewport. Position: fills remaining space, relative positioning for overlays. Contains the game canvas and minimap.
elements: #game-canvas — main 2D canvas, fills 100%×100% of wrapper, HTML canvas element
#minimap — 180×180px canvas, position:absolute bottom:8px right:8px, border 2px #4a3828, rounded, semi-transparent bg, pixelated rendering, click-to-pan

panels.description: Two-column bottom info/action bar. Height 140-200px, gradient (#1a1408→#2a2010), border-top.
elements: #info-panel (left, flex:1) — shows selected entity details. Dynamic content updated by updateUI().
.entity-stats — stat rows (HP, attack, speed, cost, etc.), 12px, color #b0a080
#action-panel (right, flex:1) — contextual action buttons. Flexbox wrap, 6px gap.
button — 100px wide, gradient bg, 2px border (#5a4a28), 12px font. Hover/active/disabled states.
button.cant-afford — red tint (#f44) when insufficient resources
.cost span — shows resource cost, color #aaa; .not-enough variant = #f44

panels.description: Floating tooltip overlay. position:absolute, pointer-events:none, dark bg with border, 12px font, white-space:nowrap. Shown/hidden based on mouse hover over action buttons.

events: mousedown — start selection box or issue command (move/attack/gather/build)
mousemove — drag selection box, camera edge-scroll, update ghost building position
contextmenu (right-click) — issue move/gather/attack order, cancel build mode (preventDefault)
Escape — deselect all / cancel build placement / cancel selection
click on minimap — pan camera to clicked location (scaled from minimap to world coords)

modes: cursor-normal — default cursor, selection and command mode
cursor-build — crosshair cursor, building placement mode (triggered by build buttons in action panel)
cursor-attack — crosshair cursor, attack-move mode (toggled by A key)
update_flow:
updateUI() called every frame (from gameLoop). Clears both #info-panel and #action-panel, then re-renders based on selection: 
• Nothing selected → info shows 'RealmCraft' welcome text, actions show build buttons for all buildings (with cost/affordability state)
• Single unit selected → shows unit name, stats (HP/atk/speed/cost/food), contextual actions (gather for peasant, attack-move for military)
• Single building selected → shows building name, HP, construction progress if building, training queue info, train-unit buttons for production buildings
• Multiple entities selected → shows 'N units selected' with aggregate info, no actions
• Ghost building (placement mode) → shows building name + cost, cancel option
